articles.title: Rupee gains 26 paise to close at 95.11 against the US dollar
articles.description: The Indian rupee gained twenty-six paise on Wednesday, ending the session at ninety-five point eleven per dollar. This positive movement was aided by a decrease in oil prices. In addition, the Reserve Bank of India opted to keep its key interest rates unchanged while awaiting more definitive inflation data, as the situation around oil prices remains unpredictable.

Meanwhile, Sandisk and Western Digital faced significant declines following disappointing earnings reports. As investors reassess stock valuations, the geopolitical context in the Middle East is increasingly influencing oil price trends.
